name: Hallowed Sigil
summary: In Shadowglen, young night elf priests are called to begin their training in Aldrassil. Conservator Ilthalaine passes along Shanda's message as novices learn to wield Elune's grace.

sections.title: A Calling to Service
sections.body: Night elf priests serve Elune as handmaidens and servants of the moon goddess. When a young kaldorei in Shadowglen shows devotion and an affinity for the divine light, Conservator Ilthalaine gives them a hallowed sigil. Shanda, the priest trainer, sent the token by messenger as an invitation to come to Aldrassil and begin spiritual training.

sections.title: A Changing World
sections.body: Shanda tells the young acolyte that unusual change has reached Teldrassil's sheltered sanctuary. Travelers fill the World Tree's boughs, including members of the wider Alliance who have leave to meet with the kaldorei. The wider world calls, but Shanda urges novices to first attend to the troubles facing Shadowglen before turning to conflicts beyond it.

faq.answer: The Hallowed Sigil is an inscribed token Shanda sent by messenger to Conservator Ilthalaine to summon a novice priest for instruction in Aldrassil.
Shanda trains priests in Aldrassil, guiding young night elf priests in the rites, disciplines, and prayers of the Sisterhood of Elune.

aliases: where to turn in hallowed sigil
faq.answer: Shanda is inside the hollow base of Aldrassil, the great central tree at the heart of Shadowglen in Teldrassil.

faq.q: Why are Alliance members visiting Teldrassil?
faq.answer: Alliance members are visiting Teldrassil to meet and confer with the kaldorei. The night elves formed ties with the Alliance after the Third War, and travelers from other races are beginning to arrive on the World Tree's boughs as both sides prepare for challenges facing Azeroth.

faq.q: What should a priest do after completing this task?
faq.answer: Shanda advises priests to help the local defenders and caretakers across Shadowglen. They can return to her to learn new prayers and techniques.

faq.q: Why does Ilthalaine give this quest?
faq.answer: Conservator Ilthalaine oversees the earliest trials of novices in Shadowglen. When Shanda's messenger arrived with the sigil, Ilthalaine kept it until the aspiring priest was ready to take the next steps.

angles.text: As a kaldorei priest, you begin formal training with Shanda in Elune's light and wisdom.
As a night elf, you belong to a people whose culture centers on the priesthood and ancient traditions of devotion to the moon, guiding them for millennia.
Shanda's words reflect the new ties between the kaldorei and the Alliance, which bring unfamiliar races and travelers to Teldrassil's boughs.
